<noinclude><pagequality level="1" user="" />{{rh|352|THE ACTES|CHA. XX.}}</noinclude>assembled together, he said to them, You knovv {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Act. 19, 1.''}}* from the first day that I entred into Asia, in vvhat maner I haue been vvith you al the time, {{verse|chapter=20|verse=19}}† seruing our Lord vvith al humilitie and teares, and tentations that did chaunce to me by the conspiracies of the Iewes: {{verse|chapter=20|verse=20}}† Hovv I haue vvithdravven nothing that vvas profitable, but that I preached it to you, & taught you openly and from house to house, {{verse|chapter=20|verse=21}}† testifying to Iewes and Gentils {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=∷ Apostolike preaching commendeth not faith only but penance also to the people.}}∷ penance tovvard God and faith in our Lord {{sc|Iesvs Christ}}. {{verse|chapter=20|verse=22}}† And now behold, being bound by the spirit, I goe to Hierusalem: not knovving vvhat things shal befall me in it, {{verse|chapter=20|verse=23}}† but that the Holy Ghost through out al cities doth protest to me, saying: that bands and tribulations abide me at Hierusalem. {{verse|chapter=20|verse=24}}† But I feare none of these things, neither doe I make my life more pretious then my self, so that I may cōsúmat my course & ministerie vvhich I receiued of our Lord {{sc|Iesvs}}, to testifie the Gospel of the grace of God. {{verse|chapter=20|verse=25}}† And novv behold I doe knovv, that you shal no more see my face al you, through whom I haue passed preaching the kingdom of God. {{verse|chapter=20|verse=26}}† Wherefore I take you to witnesse this present day that I am cleere from the bloud of al. {{verse|chapter=20|verse=27}}† For I haue not spared to declare vnto you al the counsel of God. {{verse|chapter=20|verse=28}}† Take heede to your selues and to the vvhole flocke vvherein the {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=∷ Bishops or Priests (for then these names vvere sometime vsed indifferently) gouernours of the Church of God, & placed in that roome & high function by the Holy Ghost.}}∷ Holy Ghost hath placed you bishops, to rule the Church of God vvhich he hath purchased with his ovvne bloud. {{verse|chapter=20|verse=29}}† I knovv that after my departure there vvil {{sup|‖}} rauening wolues enter in among you, not sparing the flocke. {{verse|chapter=20|verse=30}}† And out of your ovvne selues shal arise men speaking peruerse things, to draw avvay disciples after them selues. {{verse|chapter=20|verse=31}}† For the vvhich cause be vigilant, keeping in memorie that for three yeres night and day I ceased not with teares to admonish euery one of you. {{verse|chapter=20|verse=32}}† And now I commend you to God and to the vvord of his grace, vvho is able to edifie, and to giue inheritance in al the sanctified. {{verse|chapter=20|verse=33}}† No mans siluer and gold or garment haue I coueted. {{verse|chapter=20|verse=34}}† Your selues knovv that for such things as vvere needful for me and them that are vvith me, these hands haue ministred. {{verse|chapter=20|verse=35}}† I haue shevved you al things, that so labouring, you must receiue the vveake, and remember the vvord of our Lord {{sc|Iesvs}}, because he said, {{sup|‖}} It is a more blessed thing to giue rather then to take.

{{verse|chapter=20|verse=36}}† And vvhen he had said these things, falling on his knees he praied vvith al them. {{verse|chapter=20|verse=37}}† And there vvas great vveeping<noinclude>{{rh|||made}}</noinclude>
